name: Phenotype-dependent Evidence-guided Interaction Modulation
gpu_assignment: fold parity; even on GPU0, odd on GPU1
gate: 1 / (1 + absolute squared-prototype-distance difference / train-reference median difference)

candidate_go_criteria_frozen_before_trai.stage_a_evidence: median true Delta_MSE > 0 and true Delta_MSE exceeds null P95 in at least 6 of 10 folds
candidate_go_criteria_frozen_before_trai.E2_vs_E1: mean AUC delta > 0 pp, positive in at least 6 folds, leave-one-fold-out AUC delta minimum > 0 pp
candidate_go_criteria_frozen_before_trai.E3_vs_E2: mean SEN delta >= -1.0 pp and mean AUC delta >= -0.25 pp, with positive ACC or AUC in at least 6 folds
candidate_go_criteria_frozen_before_trai.E3_vs_E4: mean AUC delta > 0 pp, positive in at least 6 folds, leave-one-fold-out AUC delta minimum > 0 pp, and mean AUC delta remains > 0 pp without fold2
candidate_go_criteria_frozen_before_trai.historical_context: E3 mean ACC and AUC deltas vs historical M3 and D4 are nonnegative; E3 SEN delta vs M3 is >= -1.0 pp
candidate_go_criteria_frozen_before_trai.nontrivial_mechanism: E3 W_d norm > 1e-6 and mean training modulation relative L2 > 1e-5 in at least 8 folds
candidate_go_criteria_frozen_before_trai.interpretation: all criteria are required for CANDIDATE_GO_FOR_CONFIRMATION; otherwise NO_GO or mixed exploratory evidence

selection: validation native CE plus native graph loss only
